notes: Which of a Route 19 chunk's materials draws each kind of tile, for chunks generated from FireRed's maps (docs/research/generated-maps-spike.md §1-3). Heights are in units, 16 a tile; ground and water give the terrain's height index too. Repeats are textures a tile, as the template's own geometry has them. The tree is the template's at the box's tree, relative to the anchor, its corner on the ground. Props are res_ids of Aspertia City's bundle; a building prop's door is in tiles from its origin, and its footprint the x and z bounds of its model, in units from its origin.
